# GitHub bug triage, 2026-10-03

Curated review regressions, not a blind authoring experiment or a soundness
claim. [Validation](validation.json) records the actual scope and skipped work;
[source hashes](source-hashes.json) bind the local implementation. These are
uncommitted v0.2.8 working-tree results, not hosted CI or published fixes.

- #186 was already fixed in `f88bbc0`; rechecked and closed.
- #181/#192: search-only ancestor descriptors and a held `QrateSource` identity.
  Both root and parent replacement reject. `qrate_source_root` remains a legacy
  path query; subsequent protected loading uses `QrateSource`. This does not
  freeze regular-file contents. Older macOS kernels may still require readable
  ancestors where `O_SEARCH` is unsupported; Linux/older-runtime testing remains.
- #239/#242: the Python child runs this installation's absolute reader with
  `-P`; CLI errors use the closed v1 vocabulary. Public Python exception codes
  remain unchanged. The fake-current-directory-package test needs no PyQIR.
- #240: the terminal profile still rejects init after measurement/discard;
  the compressed contract is clarified rather than expanding the accepted subset.
- #241: native graph checking rejects unused sources. Existing proofs were
  maintained and recompiled; no new Soundness Theorem objective was pursued.
- #243/#244: source limits and I/O errors carry structured file locations;
  limit messages contain no absolute path.
- #247: bundled comments link to the frozen contract ledger; the Python README
  follows the selected version. New checks reject stale references/versions.
- #248/#249: probes and tasks share an explicit environment with pinned Rust
  and Lean; dirty/untracked trees and unreviewed task overrides reject.

`tuple/`, `source-limit/` and `terminal-init/` preserve bounded source repros;
[diagnostics](diagnostics.json) retain the actual JSON results. Race and file
permission fixtures are generated by `tests/review_v028.rs` and restore modes
before cleanup. Rust 1.98.1 passed 67 related tests; MSRV 1.85 passed 36 plus
four descriptor tests. The native QIRF suite passed 60 cases; [dual checks](dual/dual-validation.json)
passed 222 process checks and 75 small corpus clients. [Schema validation](schema-validation.json)
rebuilt/audited both Lean packages and freshly replayed the kernel; `Main` was
also freshly replayed. Rust authority and disabled external schemas are unchanged.

The installed-PyQIR suite, hosted CI, Linux/Windows/older macOS runtime checks,
and a complete clean-checkout native run were not performed. Existing historical
validation records were retained. No maximum-size quantum cases were generated.
